name: Neon Serverless Postgres MCP
shortDescription: Create database branches, execute serverless Postgres queries, manage connection pooling and auto-scaling.
longDescription: Interact with Neon Serverless Postgres platform. Create instant point-in-time database branches for preview deployments, run queries, monitor compute autoscaling, and manage API keys.
author: neondatabase

envVars.name: NEON_API_KEY
envVars.description: Neon Personal API Key generated from Account Console.

tools.name: neon_create_branch
tools.description: Create a new lightweight database branch for testing or feature isolation.

tools.name: neon_run_sql
tools.description: Run SQL statements via Neon serverless HTTP endpoint.

tools.name: neon_list_projects
tools.description: List all Neon projects and branch states.

installSteps.title: Configure Neon API Key
installSteps.description: Create an API key in Neon console and pass it in `NEON_API_KEY`.
